done_when: Approving a candidate-backed memory review saves the memory; the review card reports the real outcome (approved, failed with reason, or already decided); a Postgres test covers approving a candidate-backed review end to end

findings.body: The Postgres tests exercise real persistence, but `click()` directly invokes a captured Slack callback and manually connects it to the review handler. They bypass production dispatch (`apps/core/src/app/bootstrap/channel-message-action-router.ts:100–101`) and never exercise a running API or browser flow through Playwright. Consequently, they can pass even if application wiring prevents approval clicks from reaching the executor. Add the required running-application test with real Postgres, verifying that candidate-backed approval saves the memory and that the visible card reports approved, failed-with-reason, and already-decided outcomes, faking only third-party edges.
